provenance.repeat_runs: Five independent re-runs of the core LLM conditions, reported by the authors as an aggregate: per-run per-item outputs were not archived item-by-item, so only the maximum absolute deviation in percentage points and the stability of the conclusions are recorded.
provenance.reporting_convention: The authors observed deviations of 0.1-0.2 pt; the manuscript reports the conservative lower bound of 0.1 pt throughout.
provenance.decoding: temperature = 0 (greedy); the service exposes no reproducible seed
provenance.variation_source: service-side batching/scheduling nondeterminism, not sampling randomness
provenance.excluded: c_rw / c3r_* are deterministic rewriters with no stochastic decoding; they are not subject to run-to-run variation and are excluded here

reading_note: Because per-run item-level outputs are not archived, this table reports the maximum absolute deviation and conclusion stability, not a mean +/- SD over five per-run readings; the latter would require per-run raw outputs that do not exist in the released package.

coding.mode: single-author coding with equivalent independent review
coding.kappa_reason: Gold SQL, drift operators and the segment expressions are generated deterministically by one substitution rule (2,384 expressions); there are no human-annotated judgement units, so Cohen's kappa has no object to measure.
coding.coding_book: evolution_rules.md, prompts.md and the per-item manifest in the public package (MANIFEST.json with sha1) form the coding book for external checking
